part.text:
Fixed. The change in src/parser.y:

- Removed the now-redundant `"if" Exp "then" Exp "end"` rule.
- Added a bare `"end"` production to `ElseBody` (`gen_noop()`), so an optional `else` now works after one or more `elif` clauses, falling through to `.` identity (parser.y:622).

Verified:
- `1,2,3 | if . == 1 then 1 elif . == 2 then 2 end` → `1`, `2`, `3` (matches `else . end` semantics)
- Chained elifs, plain `if/else`, and unterminated-`if` error handling all behave correctly
- `make check`: all 7 test suites pass (jqtest, shtest, mantest, optionaltest, etc.)
